findings.title: Exposed handler reaches a sensitive operation without an authorization guard
findings.invariant: Exposed server handlers must enforce authentication or authorization before sensitive operations
prerequisites: The demonstrated handler is externally reachable
No framework-level guard exists outside the analyzed handler
findings.impact: Unauthenticated access to a sensitive operation
findings.remediation: Require an explicit authentication or authorization guard before the sink
limitations: Bounded static analysis does not model runtime framework middleware

findings.title: Untrusted path reaches a filesystem operation
findings.invariant: Filesystem paths must be constrained to an authorized root
prerequisites: An attacker can control the demonstrated path value
The process can access the target filesystem location
findings.remediation: Resolve against a fixed root, reject traversal, and enforce an allowlist
limitations: Bounded static analysis does not model runtime framework middleware

limitations.message: Phase 3 runs only the documented high-confidence JavaScript and TypeScript rules
Language-aware parsing is limited to JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, and TSX
Framework evidence is a manifest hint and not semantic proof
Symbolic links are recorded but never followed
Version-control metadata directories are never inventoried
Hidden files and directories were excluded by configuration
Inputs matched by repository ignore rules were excluded before reading
Common generated and build directories were excluded before reading
Common vendored dependency directories were excluded before reading
Nested repositories, worktrees, and submodules were excluded
Local inter-procedural propagation is bounded to 4 traversal levels
Dynamic imports, non-unique aliases, callbacks, recursion, and unresolved calls are not followed
Semantic identities, aliases, guards, and value correspondence are resolved only from deterministic local syntax within configured graph and inter-procedural bounds
Authentication supplied only by external framework middleware is not proven by this phase
Lexical path confinement does not prove runtime symlink, mount, junction, race, or filesystem permission safety
